_standing_instruction: David, 2026-08-17: 'make this research really important for all Studio sessions'. Consult before asserting any football or model number. tools/foundation-check.mjs reads this file; it is the source of truth, and prose copies of these numbers are derived, never authoritative.

corrections.wrong: yards per route run stabilises at 180+ routes / 11+ games
corrections.why: The ~184-route figure belongs to TPRR and ~188 to receptions-per-route; it was mis-attributed to YPRR. Studio's own split-half of the 180 bar returned 0.62 (~38% noise) on 912 player-seasons 2026-08-09, agreeing with the primary source.
corrections.source: Tuccitto split-half reliability, PFF 2007-13 (Intentional Rounding; recovered via Wayback)

corrections.wrong: the running-back age cliff is 26 (the value shipped in the product's code)
corrections.right: the wall is 29; 26 is barely distinguishable from 25 or 27
corrections.why: At 29: 92% of survivors decline, 14 of 27 gone the next season, median including the departed -100%. Measured in-house across 2018-2025.

corrections.wrong: the receiver age cliff is 28 (shipped in code)
corrections.right: the drop is at 27; receivers run above baseline through 26

corrections.wrong: RELAY 024 R3: "No shipped sort currently mixes positions on DVS (checked: no comparator in frontend/src references it)."
corrections.right: A cross-position DVS comparator DOES exist — roster_cut_engine._tier_sort_key:171-180 sorts a mixed-position roster by (tier, score) with score = dvs for tiers B and C. It is dormant on the live roster: 20 of 21 cut candidates take the tier-A xVAR path and the shipped order is monotone in raw xVAR; the one remaining player has no score at all. So the claim was right in effect and wrong in method.
corrections.why: The check was scoped to the layer Studio happened to search. A "nothing references it" claim is a claim about the whole system, and searching one layer cannot support it. Engineering found it in src/dynasty_genius/ in one pass.

corrections.wrong: RELAY 024 R5 cited "PRODUCT_BRIEFING.md §4" to an engineering audience as though it were a file in the product repository.
corrections.right: PRODUCT_BRIEFING.md exists only in ~/frontend-studio — it is Studio's own engagement briefing. The product repository has no such file, so the citation was unresolvable for the reader.
corrections.why: A citation is only useful if the reader can open it. Never cite a studio-side document to the engineers; quote the product's own text instead (here: ParkedSurfaceCard.tsx:23).

corrections.wrong: This register's own headline: 'DVS = projection_2y x a per-position constant', stated without qualification, and 'DVS carries NO information beyond the projection'.
corrections.right: True for ENGINE_B (503 rows). FALSE for the 80 ENGINE_A prospect rows, which carry a DVS and no projection at all, computed against different references.
corrections.why: Studio measured the ratio only on rows where BOTH fields were present, which silently excluded every row where one was missing. A ratio computed on the intersection cannot support a claim about the union. Found on 2026-08-18 while checking an engineering refinement, not by the instrument.

thresholds.value: 20% clears WR2-or-better for 92% of finishers since 2006

thresholds.note: 'Stabilises' means HALF SIGNAL, HALF NOISE — it is not a green light. The hobby uses it as one.

repeatability.note: THE NAIVE BASELINE BEATS EVERY ADVANCED METRIC. An advanced panel must justify itself by explaining SHAPE, never by claiming better prediction.

age.baseline_note: The median qualifying player loses 17.1% of his PPG year over year AT EVERY AGE (n=956, all positions pooled). Read every age-decline figure as a difference from this. Most published age-decline numbers are measuring selection, not ageing.

measured.QB: UNMEASURABLE — too few per age-year in 8 seasons. A hole, not a pass.

age.design_rule: An age cliff is a CATEGORICAL LABEL ON A CONTINUOUS, NOISY QUANTITY and lies at the boundary. Draw the curve with its uncertainty and position the player on it; never a binary flag.
age.what_the_constants_actually_drive: CLIFF_AGES (roster_cut_engine.py:12-17) is consumed only by _age_cliff_warning:154-158, which returns a boolean for human-readable warnings. The predictive models consume fitted continuous curves and encode no binary cliff. So a mis-calibrated constant here is a DISPLAY defect, not a model defect. (Engineering, 2026-08-18.) Live consequence: Roster Audit renders an "approaching_cliff (Ny)" label per row driven by these constants — e.g. Rasheen Ali, RB 25, reads "approaching_cliff (1y)" against a measured wall at 29. Also: these four ages are fixed in the product's own written rules, so changing one is not a code-level edit.
age.caveat_on_the_measurement: Attrition and production are different statistics and only one of them is well powered here. "14 of 27 gone the next season" is attrition; "-32.1 vs baseline" is production. At RB-29 cell sizes only the attrition figure is well powered — conflating them overstates the wall. (Engineering's caveat, accepted 2026-08-18.)

quarterback.trap: Every marquee QB analytic — EPA/play, CPOE, DAKOTA, time to throw — is PASSING-ONLY. A rushing yard is worth 2.5x a passing yard, and every QB1 since 2019 posted >=350 rush yards and >=4 rush TDs. In Superflex a QB surface built from those metrics ranks the wrong players.

superflex_qb_premium.note: FantasyCalc's is a FIXED multiplier applied to every QB — a model parameter, not a market observation. KTC re-crowdsources superflex separately, which also makes every NON-QB worth ~18% less.

dynasty_market.rank_vs_value: Values are NOT comparable across sources; ranks largely are. All three ecosystems agree a top-24 QB gains +40 to +45 overall rank spots going 1QB -> Superflex. Compare in rank space.

rookie_pick_hit_rates.note: Outcomes are step-shaped by round while the market prices picks continuously across the round boundary (1.12 -> 2.01 is only -5.3%).

dynasty_market.recency_premium: Normally nearer years are worth more, BUT it is currently INVERTED: a 2027 Early 1st prices above a 2026 Early 1st (weak 2026 class). Any pick model hard-coding 'sooner = more' is broken by construction.

our_model.what_it_forecasts: 2-year average PPG (per the published model card).

dvs_is_derived.formula: dynasty_value_score = projection_2y x per-position constant, clipped to [0,100]
dvs_is_derived.consequence_1: DVS carries NO information beyond the projection IN THE UNCLAMPED REGION, where it is a strictly monotone rescaling and can be spoken as fantasy points per game with no modelling change. In the clamped region information is DESTROYED, not transformed. The honest sentence is: DVS is PPG rescaled AND truncated. (Engineering's refinement, 2026-08-18.)
dvs_is_derived.consequence_2: DVS is NOT comparable across positions: DVS 50 = 10.05 PPG for a QB but 4.70 for a TE.
dvs_is_derived.consequence_3: The clip at 100 pins the elite: 6 WRs (spanning 5.76 PPG of real difference), 11 of 89 TEs, 5 RBs. Our model cannot separate Ja'Marr Chase from George Pickens.
dvs_is_derived.formula_at_source: dvs_raw = projection_2y / ENGINE_B_P90_PPG[pos] * 100.0; dynasty_value_score = round(min(100, max(0, dvs_raw)), 1). So the per-position constant is 100 / P90. ENGINE_B_P90_PPG = QB 20.1 / RB 15.7 / WR 14.5 / TE 9.4.
dvs_is_derived.confirmed_by_engineering: 2026-08-18. pvo_assembler.py:390-407 and engine_b_contract.py:24-29. The clamp is applied to the value that ships. Studio's four measured constants reproduce to within 0.001.
dvs_is_derived.clamp_is_silent: player_value_object.py:85 defines dvs_clamped ('True if raw DVS exceeded 100 before clamping') and the assembler computes it, but NO served payload carries it and no dvs_p90_ref key exists. Verified independently 2026-08-18: 'dvs_clamped' appears in neither frontend/src/lib/api/types.gen.ts nor app/api/routes/. The ceiling is applied where the reader cannot see it.
dvs_is_derived.live_instance_on_davids_roster: Tucker Kraft (TE): projection_2y 10.329 PPG -> raw DVS 109.9 -> served 100.0, indistinguishable from a true 100. Measured 2026-08-18.
dvs_is_derived.SCOPE_LIMIT_ENGINE_A: THE FORMULA HOLDS FOR ENGINE B ONLY, and this register overclaimed it until 2026-08-18. In universe_pvo_runtime.json (12,222 rows, captured 2026-08-18T13:30Z): ENGINE_B has 503 rows, all carrying projection_2y, and all 388 scored rows reproduce clamp(projection_2y/P90*100, 0, 100) to within 0.15. ENGINE_A has 80 rows, ALL 80 carry a dynasty_value_score and NOT ONE carries any projection — so for prospects the score is not a rescaled projection and 'DVS carries no information beyond the projection' is FALSE for them. Engine A also uses DIFFERENT references: WR 12.7, QB 16.7, TE 9.1, RB 14.6, against Engine B's 14.5 / 20.1 / 9.4 / 15.7. So the same 0-100 number on a surface is two different constructions against two different denominators, and DVS is not comparable across ENGINES within a position, not merely across positions.
dvs_is_derived.floor_clamp_also_fires: max(0, ...) is a clamp too. KhaDarel Hodge carries projection_2y -0.753 (a negative projected PPG), raw DVS -5.2, served 0.0. With both clamps applied, ALL 388 scored Engine-B rows reproduce clamp(projection_2y / P90 * 100, 0, 100) to within 0.15 — Hodge is an instance of the floor clamp, not an exception to the formula. Studio first reported him as a formula failure, having omitted the clamp from its own check; tools/is-dvs-one-quantity.py corrected it.
dvs_is_derived.dvs_clamped_now_in_the_artifact: Engineering, 2026-08-18: dvs_clamped and dvs_p90_ref are now written into the producer artifact. Verified: 23 rows carry dvs_clamped true, and each carries its engine's correct dvs_p90_ref. Still absent from the API schema, the generated client and every route file. Precise state: the data layer records the truncation, the served surface does not. Studio's original claim ('computed and never served') was correct in effect and too broad in scope.

vs_market_ndcg_at_24.note: OUR MODEL DOES NOT OUT-RANK THE MARKET ANYWHERE. Behind at QB and RB, a coin-flip at WR and TE, on the app's own published backtest. No surface may imply our number should be trusted over the market's.
vs_market_ndcg_at_24.reproduction_note: Engineering did not rerun the harness or the fold definitions (2026-08-18), so these figures are neither endorsed nor disputed by them. They remain Studio's own measurement off the published backtest.

divergence_validity.status: None for all four positions — UNEVALUATED. A divergence is an observation, not a signal.
divergence_validity.why: Deferred pending data, NOT never-computed and NOT computed-and-withheld. backtest_artifact.py:163 defaults it to None; backtest_harness.py:319-320 maps None to a deferred status and "insufficient_data" below n_flagged 30. The input is forward-accrued point-in-time market data, which does not exist yet by construction.
divergence_validity.design_consequence: Every two-lane surface must speak divergence as an observation until then. This is a dated constraint with roughly four months to run, not a permanent one.
divergence_validity.app_already_says_so_in_one_place: Daily What-Changed renders: "Divergence card counts are an unvalidated descriptive overlay (Gate-4 deferred); a tally of card types, not a proven edge." Observed live 2026-08-18.

our_model.board_movement: Scores changed on 2 of 54 capture days (2026-06-26; a 0.1-DVS twitch 2026-08-14). Our lane is a standing opinion, not a live one. Never draw it as moving.

category_conventions.boom_bust_is_rank_relative: 'Boom' and 'bust' are NOT fixed point totals — they are the average weekly score of a rank slot at that position (QB boom = 27.3+, the average QB3 week; RB boom = 19.4+, the average RB6 week). Position-relative, self-labelling, and it survives a scoring-format change. Independently corroborated by a second method built from 2025 season data.
category_conventions.uncertainty_is_never_drawn: FantasyPros prints uncertainty as four numbers (best / worst / average / std-dev) and draws it NOWHERE — no whiskers, no interval bars, anywhere on the product. The scatter-with-error-bars people associate with tiers is borischen.co, not FantasyPros. This is the strongest available argument for DRAWING the interval in a dynasty tool (and it agrees with craft principle 6).
category_conventions.ecr_is_two_different_things: A draft ranking is a consensus of 88 experts; a weekly ranking is a consensus of 8. Both ship under the identical label 'ECR'. Never treat the two as the same quantity.
category_conventions.staleness_is_first_class: FantasyPros shows per-expert freshness in human units ('5 h', '1 d', '2 w') and makes it SORTABLE — the most honest detail on any product in the category, and directly transferable to a product whose own lane has not moved since June.
category_conventions.no_single_rankings_column_order: There is a View: selector with five column sets; the default (Upside/Bust/SOS) is not the classic BEST/WORST/AVG/STD.DEV set. There is no TEAM column and no ADP column — team folds into the player cell and ADP survives only as an 'ECR VS. ADP' delta.
category_conventions.source: L1-standard-fantasy-football.md §8, read from server-rendered HTML and embedded JSON config rather than the rendered view

small_sample_rendering.shrinkage: (observed x N + league_average x S) / (N + S). Continuous, cannot lie at a boundary, and the gap between raw and shrunk IS the drawable uncertainty.
small_sample_rendering.savant_discipline: Baseball Savant nulls all 105 percent_rank fields when is_qualified = 0 and prints the words 'NOT QUALIFIED' — a categorical refusal, never a faded bar. Its axis reads POOR - AVERAGE - GREAT and colour is normalised so the hue means percentile, never magnitude.

unserved_data.the_precise_repair: ParkedSurfaceCard.tsx:23 reads: "This surface needs in-season usage signals (routes, snaps) that only accrue while games are played; building it now would ship an empty surface." Routes and snaps for 2018-2025 exist on disk. What does not exist is the CURRENT-SEASON 2026 vintage. The sentence implies the data CLASS is absent when only the vintage is.

Measured 2026-08-18, tools/do-two-surfaces-agree-about-the-model.py.
